procedure.en: Turn the adjustment nut clockwise until it stops at the number 0 for the final time. That is zero; do not tighten it with force. Turn counter-clockwise and count clicks from there. The number on the nut may not equal the click count, so count clicks.
procedure.pt-BR: Gire a porca de ajuste no sentido horário até parar no número 0 pela última vez. Esse é o zero; não force. Gire no sentido anti-horário e conte os cliques a partir dali. O número na porca pode não coincidir com a contagem de cliques, então conte os cliques.

notes: Discontinued. 60 clicks per rotation and 16 µm per click of burr travel (Kingrinder's K4 vs K6 comparison), not particle size. Kingrinder's own K4 click chart was not found; the K6 manual's values are used because Kingrinder states the two share the mechanism, and Honest Coffee Guide publishes the same chart for both. The K6 manual's 'do not grind below 15 clicks' warning is applied.
